title: Microsoft Teams Apps & Integration Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft 365 Teams administration).

MicrosoftTeams PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Govern which apps and bots run inside Microsoft Teams
problem: Every app added to Teams gains access to collaboration data — ungoverned, it's an unmanaged supply chain. This solution governs Teams apps and integrations: app permission and setup policies, org-wide allow/block and pinning, custom/line-of-business and third-party app management, admin consent and Graph-permission review, and an app-vetting workflow — so only trusted, useful apps are available.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the app-governance model: app permission + setup policies, allow/block + pinning, custom/LOB vs third-party, consent/permission review, and vetting.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams admin roles, app catalog, security/governance stakeholders, risk criteria).

Implementation Guide — set app permission + setup policies, configure allow/block + pinning, manage custom/LOB uploads, review consent/Graph permissions, and wire an app-vetting workflow — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (only vetted apps available, risky permissions reviewed) plus Best Practices for ongoing app governance.
short: Govern Teams apps & integrations — app permission/setup policies, allow/block + pinning, custom/LOB + third-party management, consent/permission review, and a vetting workflow — so only trusted apps run in Teams. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.

bottom_line: Only trusted, useful apps in Teams — permission and setup policies set, risky apps blocked, consent reviewed, new apps vetted — the collaboration supply chain governed.
